## Project Summary

A colorful, interactive Bible quiz web application designed for children using the Reina Valera 1960 version. Features three difficulty levels, 30 biblical questions, score tracking, and performance feedback. Fully responsive and requires no installation or server.

To launch: Open `index.html` in any web browser.
